# Application Server Configuration Guide

This document describes how to configure and manage the Acme application server.

## Deployment

The application server runs on port 8080. To start the server:

1. SSH into the production host at prod-server-01.acme.internal
2. Navigate to /opt/acme/app
3. Run `./start.sh --port 8080`
4. Verify the server is running: `curl http://localhost:8080/health`

The health endpoint should return `{"status": "ok"}`.

## Database Connection

The server connects to the PostgreSQL database at db-primary.acme.internal:5432.
Connection pool size is set to 20 by default.

Configuration file: /etc/acme/database.yml

```yaml
host: db-primary.acme.internal
port: 5432
pool_size: 20
database: acme_production
```

## Logging

Logs are written to /var/log/acme/app.log. Log rotation is configured via logrotate with a 7-day retention period. Log level is set to INFO in production.

## SSL/TLS

The server uses a self-signed certificate located at /etc/acme/ssl/server.crt. Certificate renewal is manual and should be done every 12 months.
